acceptanceCriteria: A run reported as completed has actually transitioned its tasks and its campaign, or it is not reported as completed
Accepted work does not remain permanently claimed
Budget spend, retry counts, and lane-failure counts survive a process restart rather than resetting on every invocation
A paused or partially claimed campaign can be resumed without the start path rejecting its own claimed tasks
No test asserts an outcome of completed while also asserting the durable campaign or task is not
deliverables: Durable completion in src/campaign/supervisor.ts: task review and completion transitions, campaign status, and integration of accepted commits
Durable budget and retry accounting, replacing the run-local trackers
Resume path in src/campaign/recovery.ts that reconciles with the declared transition table
Tests rewritten to assert the durable state matches what the CLI reports
title: Make campaign completion durable instead of memory-only

decisionEnvelope: Whether completion drives the task transitions itself or delegates to an explicit landing step
Where budget, retry, and lane-failure state becomes durable so a resumed run does not reset it
How an already-claimed task is resumed without the current start-path rejection
